newsitem.title: USA: Minn. gov signs $400 mln for 98-99 family programs.
newsitem.headline: Minn. gov signs $400 mln for 98-99 family programs.

text.p: Minnesota Gov. Arne Carlson signed an appropriations bill giving nearly $400 million for family and early childhood programs for the fiscal biennium beginning July 1.
The spending plan signed on Friday allots $92.5 million to a sliding fee child care program and $37.5 million for Head Start, according to a news release from the governor's office.

The legislation also includes $29 million for early childhood family education, $25 million for adult basic education, more than $20 million for a learning readiness program, $18 million for economic opportunity grants and $10 million for school enrichment.
Lawmakers hope to finish work on the biennium budget by midnight Monday.
